blind.table_distance_name: stone wall segment with arched alcove
blind.description: A freestanding rectangular section of masonry wall constructed from dark grey or black stone blocks with mortar lines. It features a recessed arched alcove trimmed with red or terracotta-colored voussoirs and a matching red stone sill. Resting inside the alcove (clearly visible in tile D) is a multi-spiked fleshy or coral-like beige organic cluster. Surfaces are solid, flat, and continuous with no hovering, melted, or broken geometry.
blind.from_above: A simple dark charcoal elongated rectangle, showing the flat masonry top of the wall section.
blind.height_vs_figure: The wall is slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (approximately 6 feet tall) and about 3 feet wide.
